description:
## Goal

Install permanent production-API telemetry that measures exact product work across a cold root request and later requests in the same long-lived Compiler2. The report must separate population, displacement, recursive publication, retained reuse, and producer evaluation so later optimization tickets remove proven work.

The two determinism prerequisites are complete: fz-tfn.25 makes recursive-search counts and traversal work reproducible, and fz-tfn.26 makes typed completion/publication waves independent of hash seed. This ticket accepts no cross-process causal-work exception. fz-tfn.2 still owns reproducible recursive-group membership after the later RuntimeDemand graph cutover; that future graph change does not waive any mismatch on the current graph.

## Required measurements

For each target fixture, record one causal report covering:

1. cold root request;
2. unchanged second request in the same Compiler2;
3. redefinition of an unreachable function followed by the same root request;
4. redefinition of one reached leaf followed by the same root request;
5. redefinition that retracts one old callee and introduces another.

Count by exact structured ProductKey and request: first production, retained cache hit, displacement, reproduction, equal reproduction, distinct demanded keys and generations, producer evaluations, exact causing fact/product movement, recursive search counts/work, scheduler evaluations/work-start reason, and final reachable executable/wrapper population.

## Output contract

- Product request, producer evaluation, settlement, cache hit, displacement, and recursive-peer publication are distinct.
- Identity and causality use raw structured values; formatted Debug, display, or canonical Ty strings are never logic or authority.
- Requests within one Compiler2 cannot be conflated.
- Every non-initial evaluation names exact dependency movement or is reported as unexplained. Unexplained work is visible evidence, never excluded or assigned an invented adjacent cause.
- Recursive search counts, traversal work, publication membership, and cache behavior are all part of the exact current-graph comparand.
- The harness observes production APIs, remains as the machine-independent work-count regression signal, and introduces no stopwatch threshold or shadow cache.
- Temporary counters, comparison switches, exception helpers, generated transition data, and migration scaffolding are removed before completion.

## Acceptance

- Reproducible baseline reports cover 00420_enum_take_drop_split, enum_predicate_search, and fz_f98_range_map_converges.
- Cold population, within-request churn, and cross-request recomputation are distinct dimensions.
- Unchanged and irrelevant-edit cases expose current fresh-session repopulation directly.
- Recursive search work is attributable to changed dependency edges versus discovery and is stable across processes.
- Independent processes produce identical complete canonical causal-work multisets with zero exclusions.
- Documentation explains how to reproduce and read the report, truthfully names any unexplained count, and distinguishes the current exact graph from the later graph owned by fz-tfn.2.
- Focused telemetry and multi-request tests, all three fixture doors, exact cross-process comparisons, the full library, the single-thread fixture matrix, formatting, and strict warning-free clippy pass.

This ticket installs and measures the signal. It does not optimize the compiler.

comments.text: Authorized DAG split: fz-tfn.25 is the prerequisite for stable current-graph search-work telemetry. Exact recursive group membership remains an explicit temporary report dimension until fz-kdt.4 then fz-tfn.2.

fz-tfn.25 found one pre-existing enum_predicate_search causal gap on c521: DeriveExecutableFacts for Enum.any?/2#lambda@4599-4650/2 over main lambda@3054-3113 re-evaluates after settled ActivationAnalyzed/CallSiteSummary movement, changes nothing, then blocks on ActivationAnalyzed. The triggering AnalyzeActivation completion carries the target poststates only in movements, not changed before/after, so replay classifies no cause. Exact command: target/debug/fz2 --log-telemetry TRACE interp fixtures2/behavior/enum_predicate_search.fz. The current fz-kdt.46 exact-wait candidate eliminates this gap; its three-target reads+blocked causal regression is green. Recheck and remove any temporary exception when fz-kdt.46 is integrated before closing kdt.5.

Cross-process isolation found identical 2,978 scheduler completion/movement/wake/read records; the first divergence is intra-completion canonical-definition emission order from DeriveCallGraphComponent, which reorders recursive-group settlements and downstream TransportShape/CallableConstruction causality. This belongs to fz-tfn.26 typed completion ordering, not a telemetry exception. Added fz-tfn.26 as a prerequisite; re-run the exact per-key causal gate after its typed comparator lands.

title: Establish cold and incremental product-work causality before optimization
